# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.next = next
class Solution:
    def plusOne(self, head: Optional[ListNode]) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        dummy = ListNode(0, head)
        target = dummy
        while head:
            if head.val != 9:
                target = head
            head = head.next
        target.val += 1
        target = target.next
        while target:
            target.val = 0
            target = target.next
        return dummy if dummy.val else dummy.next
